q1_issues.issue: (Future sk_start_1) is asserted although the item supplies no TODAY and 'in September' is not a lexically future adjunct, so the Time section's futurate rule requires no tense atom at all and lets the unmarked default stand.

q2_gaps: aspectual begin/start whose subject IS the eventuality, with no 'to V' complement ('the apple harvest starts'): the Inception section only schematizes 'X started to V' (subject = Agent or the intransitive-subject role, Theme = a separate activity witness marked Ongoing), so it does not say whether the subject-eventuality takes Theme or the change-of-state Patient, nor whether Ongoing applies when subject and activity collapse into one symbol
notes: The 'start' lemma is kept surface-faithful as required, and the compound genus and (Month september) term are correct; the futurate tense atom is the only defect.
